title: Arena loss 11/23/2026: Siren, Transport, Wharf

sources.author: dominion.games
sources.note: Rated game: Gemini 4 Neon (high) as AstraDominion lost 18-38 to a human at level 56

sources.author: dominion-agent-review
sources.note: Neon vs Neon on this kingdom, seeds 1-3 in both seat orders, one seat told the Siren insight: the told seat won 5 of 6

quality_note: One human game showed the line, and six seeded Neon-vs-Neon games confirmed it: the seat told to open Transport into Siren won five, three of three moving first and two of three moving second. Margins were often small; the Curse split decided them.

kingdom.setup_notes: In the source game the top Hex was Delusion and the top Loot was Sword.

edition: Current (second-edition) texts, as on dominion.games in November 2026.
